mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained downward trend (3 consecutive monthly declines).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by strong consumer spending, a sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST and RSAFS both rise for three consecutive months during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate indicates a tightening labor market, which typically leads to higher wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE shows a sustained downward trend (3 consecutive monthly declines).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an extremely tight labor market that may lead to inflationary pressures and central bank intervention, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime marked by declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing bottlenecks reduce corporate profitability, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is declining (3 consecutive monthly declines) during a supply-constrained regime.
